questions.question: What single word did my incoming transmission contain?
questions.expected_answer: LANTERN.

questions.question: What clue led me to the service door?
questions.expected_answer: Fresh scrape marks along the plating that continued beneath the door.

questions.question: How did I recognize the survey drone's owner?
questions.expected_answer: Its orange survey tape matched the tape on Odile’s equipment cases.

questions.question: What happened to the cable I tried using as a shield?
questions.expected_answer: The gas jet tore it from your glove and swept it through the breach.

questions.question: What was blocking my access to the recessed manual catch?
questions.expected_answer: A cable bundle running across the panel’s upper edge and behind its frame.

questions.question: How did I reconnect the circular coupling?
questions.expected_answer: By bracing the conduit, aligning the plug with the socket, and tightening the collar by hand.

questions.question: What did the conduit warning tell me to avoid?
questions.expected_answer: Repeated clamp cycles.

questions.question: Which command did I use to disengage the docking clamps?
questions.expected_answer: RELEASE CLAMPS.

questions.question: Which part of the repaired conduit was under mechanical strain?
questions.expected_answer: Its exposed coupling.

questions.question: What did the power conduit warning tell me to avoid?
questions.expected_answer: Repeated clamp cycles.

questions.question: What risk would I take by removing part of the modular cargo bay?
questions.expected_answer: Compromising how cargo is secured.

questions.question: Where did I pick up the portable O2 canister?
questions.expected_answer: From the equipment locker aboard the Kestrel.

questions.question: How did I free the manual catch?
questions.expected_answer: By pulling it while pushing the obstructing cable bundle aside through the gap.

questions.question: What kept me from searching deeper for Dr. Brandt?
questions.expected_answer: Gas venting from the breach made the deeper passage unsafe to enter.

questions.question: What damage did I find on the survey drone?
questions.expected_answer: Its rotor arm was sharply bent against its body.

questions.question: What made the route beyond the buckled section unsafe for me?
questions.expected_answer: Escaping gas was venting across the route.

questions.question: What was the word in the final transmission I found in the survey logs?
questions.expected_answer: Lantern.

questions.question: Which transmission did I learn had survived the file damage?
questions.expected_answer: The “Lantern” transmission.

questions.question: Where did the proprietor suggest I look for buyers?
questions.expected_answer: At the salvage counters.

questions.question: What did the trader tell me they don't keep track of?
questions.expected_answer: Wreck locations in the belt.

questions.question: How much did I sell the cracked slate for?
questions.expected_answer: 180 credits.

questions.question: What was the pawnbroker's policy on introducing me to buyers?
questions.expected_answer: He doesn't broker introductions or point customers to other buyers.

questions.question: How many credits did I offer Brother Calix?
questions.expected_answer: 300 credits.

questions.question: What did I pay for the navigation core?
questions.expected_answer: 300 credits and Odile’s brass compass.

questions.question: What did installing the navigation core let me do again?
questions.expected_answer: Calculate routes through the debris belt.

questions.question: Why couldn't I brace the exposed coupling any further?
questions.expected_answer: The surrounding structure offered no solid point to brace it against.

questions.question: What accusation did I make against the guard?
questions.expected_answer: That he had been stealing from the cargo holds.

questions.question: What compensation did the guards offer me?
questions.expected_answer: A share of the supplies, or credits at a price they would consider.

questions.question: Which department did I say Aiden Kessler worked in?
questions.expected_answer: The Logistics Department.

questions.question: How much did I sell the cracked data slate for?
questions.expected_answer: 180 credits.

questions.question: What were my options for the pending access request?
questions.expected_answer: Wait for Kessler’s confirmation or withdraw the request.

questions.question: What hull damage did I find after the ambush?
questions.expected_answer: Fresh scoring and a shallow crease along the cargo-bay plating, with no puncture or escaping air.

questions.question: Where did I suggest we go for proper bracing materials?
questions.expected_answer: Port Halcyon.

questions.question: How much did I pay for the structural braces?
questions.expected_answer: 420 credits.

questions.question: How many credits short was I of buying the spare plating?
questions.expected_answer: 120 credits.

questions.question: Where did I first localize the beacon signal?
questions.expected_answer: The Tessaly cloud skimmer platform itself, not somewhere beyond it.

questions.question: What blocked my way to the beacon?
questions.expected_answer: A panel with a small gap along one edge.

questions.question: How did I release the beacon's contact cover?
questions.expected_answer: By pressing both recessed catches simultaneously.

questions.question: Did the beacon's signal lead me to another location?
questions.expected_answer: No. The beacon itself was the source; moving away revealed no location or route beyond the platform.

questions.question: Where couldn't the receiver guide me?
questions.expected_answer: Beyond the platform; it could only confirm the transmission came from the beacon.

questions.question: Could I adjust the beacon’s transmission strength?
questions.expected_answer: No. The beacon had no transmission-strength setting or boost control.

questions.question: What operations did I find documented in the skimmer’s records?
questions.expected_answer: Only the skimmer’s own sampling operations, with no beacon transmission records.

questions.question: Why did I leave the laboratory cables intact?
questions.expected_answer: There was no clear connection point to use to restore power.

questions.question: Did I find any physical records about the Lantern project?
questions.expected_answer: No, there were no physical files or documents mentioning the Lantern project.

questions.question: What did my search of the laboratory’s adjacent rooms turn up?
questions.expected_answer: No usable power source.

questions.question: What did the proprietor tell me they couldn't remember?
questions.expected_answer: Who bought Odile’s cracked data slate and survey logs.

questions.question: What buyer details did I find in the pawnshop ledger?
questions.expected_answer: None—the ledger contained no buyer name or contact information.

questions.question: What buyer details couldn't I get from the pawnshop ledger?
questions.expected_answer: The buyer’s name or contact information.

questions.question: What couldn't the supervisor provide in my place?
questions.expected_answer: Your authorization for Priya’s release.

questions.question: Why was I told not to use the plasma cutter in lockup?
questions.expected_answer: Because it was a security station.

questions.question: What did Priya want me to check before buying supplies?
questions.expected_answer: The reactor and life support readings.

questions.question: What did my follow-up reactor diagnostic confirm?
questions.expected_answer: Stable regulation with no active faults, and steady life-support readings.

questions.question: What did I use to stabilize the docking-ring conduit?
questions.expected_answer: Structural braces.

questions.question: What did I use to press the bent retaining clip into place?
questions.expected_answer: The insulated tool.

questions.question: What did Voren forbid me from doing before checking the pressure?
questions.expected_answer: Cutting into the transfer hatch.

questions.question: What access methods did the guards say they couldn't offer me?
questions.expected_answer: An access code or override.

questions.question: What was I searching for beyond the cut transfer hatch?
questions.expected_answer: Signs of Hal Voren or potential traps.

questions.question: What couldn't my suit sensors tell me about anyone farther away?
questions.expected_answer: Whether anyone was beyond the sensors’ range.

questions.question: What did I check after failing to activate my portable O2 canister?
questions.expected_answer: My suit supply.

questions.question: Did my suit scanner find anything that could help restore power?
questions.expected_answer: No—it detected no active electronic equipment nearby.
